rows.name: DENS
rows.range: Grain rate or density, depending on grain ratio mode

rows.name: SPRAY
rows.range: 0 – full sample (or FFT block in spectral)

rows.name: LAYER VOL
rows.description: Layer volume (targets layers on the received MIDI channel)

rows.name: PITCH PER GRAIN
rows.range: 0: same pitch across voice, 1: per-grain pitch

rows.name: ARP MODE
rows.range: 0: up, 1: down, 2: updown, 3: downup, 4: random, 5: shuffle, 6: fwd, 7: rev, 8: fwd-rev, 9: rev-fwd

rows.name: WINDOW AM
rows.range: Raised-cosine only: AM freq relative to grain size

rows.name: FX TYPE
rows.range: 0: None, 1: Chorus, 2: Compressor, 3: Delay, 4: PPDelay, 5: Dist, 6: EQ3, 7: Flanger, 8: Large Reverb, 9: Reducer, 10: Resonator (MBR), 11: Reverb, 12: Ring Mod, 13: Saturator, 14: Vibrato

rows.name: ALL SOUND OFF
rows.range: Kills all sound on layer including FX tails

rows.name: ALL NOTES OFF
rows.range: Releases all notes on layer (envelopes keep running)

rows.name: CURVE FILTER ATTACK
rows.range: same curve semantics as pitch curves

rows.name: FFT BEND
rows.range: bipolar (64 = neutral); narrow deadzone, useful range is a few % around center

rows.name: KEYTRACK
rows.curve: routes ModSo urce::K eyTrac k → ModD est::Cu toff in the mod matrix

rows.name: RATE FREE
rows.description: Grain rate, free/unsynced (targets free value directly)

rows.name: RATE SYNCED
rows.description: Grain rate, clock-synced (targets synced value directly)

rows.name: ENGINE KNOB A
rows.description: Engine knob A (context: FFT amp thresh / density / grain rate)

rows.name: ENGINE KNOB B
rows.description: Engine knob B (context: FFT size / density / grain size)

rows.name: DRAW RATE
rows.curve: knob axis is revers ed vs preset index (up = faster)
